xhs.title: 没有垃圾回收，Rust 内存谁来管？
xhs.body:
第 6 课：所有权的三条规则
① 每个值都有一个主人
② 同一时刻只有一个主人
③ 主人离开作用域，值自动清理
你学所有权时卡在哪一条？评论区聊聊～

douyin.title: 一分钟记住 Rust 所有权三条规则
douyin.body: 一个值，一个主人；主人走了，值就跟着走。

tiktok.body: No garbage collector, no manual free. Rust manages memory with 3 ownership rules.

linkedin.title: Rust has no garbage collector. Here's who frees the memory.
linkedin.body:
Rule 1: every value has an owner.
Rule 2: there is only one owner at a time. Assign it away, and the old name can't be used.
Rule 3: when the owner goes out of scope, the value is dropped.
All checked at compile time, so there's no runtime cost.
Which rule tripped you up first?
